vocabulary.meaning_en: a small round fruit that grows in bunches

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large green fruit with red, juicy flesh
vocabulary.example: Watermelon is perfect on a hot day.
vocabulary.note_en: water + melon = a melon full of water.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small red fruit with tiny seeds on the outside
vocabulary.note_ar: في الأمريكية تُمدّ -berry، وفي البريطانية تُختصر
vocabulary.example: I like strawberries with cream.
vocabulary.note_en: In American English the "-berry" part is said fully; in British English it is said shorter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small round red fruit with a stone inside
vocabulary.example: There is a cherry on top of the cake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a soft round fruit with fuzzy skin
vocabulary.example: This peach is sweet and juicy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sweet fruit, narrow at the top and wide at the bottom
vocabulary.example: He cut a pear into slices.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large tropical fruit with rough skin and sweet yellow flesh
vocabulary.note_ar: pine (الصنوبر) + apple: شكله يشبه كوز الصنوبر
vocabulary.example: We added pineapple to the fruit salad.
vocabulary.note_en: pine + apple: it looks like a pine cone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sour yellow fruit
vocabulary.example: Add some lemon juice to the fish.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sour green fruit like a small lemon
vocabulary.example: She squeezed a lime into her drink.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long green vegetable eaten raw in salads
vocabulary.example: I put cucumber and tomato in my salad.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long orange vegetable that grows under the ground
vocabulary.example: Rabbits love carrots.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a round vegetable with a strong smell that makes you cry when you cut it
vocabulary.example: Fry the onion until it is golden.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plant with a strong taste used in cooking
vocabulary.example: This sauce has too much garlic.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a green leafy vegetable used in salads
vocabulary.example: Wash the lettuce before you eat it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a vegetable with dark green leaves
vocabulary.example: Spinach is full of iron.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large round vegetable made of thick leaves
vocabulary.example: My mother makes stuffed cabbage leaves.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a green vegetable that looks like a small tree
vocabulary.example: Steamed broccoli is very healthy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a vegetable with a large white head
vocabulary.note_ar: cauli (ساق الكرنب باللاتينية) + flower (زهرة) = زهرة الكرنب
vocabulary.example: We had fried cauliflower for lunch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hollow vegetable that can be red, green or yellow; also a hot spice
vocabulary.example: Cut the red pepper into strips.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small, very hot pepper
vocabulary.example: This soup has chili in it, so be careful.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tall plant with yellow seeds that we eat
vocabulary.example: We grilled corn on the beach.

vocabulary.meaning_en: small round green seeds eaten as a vegetable
vocabulary.example: Add the peas to the rice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a vegetable with shiny dark purple skin
vocabulary.note_ar: egg + plant: بعض أنواعه صغيرة وبيضاء مثل البيضة. في بريطانيا اسمه aubergine
vocabulary.example: Grilled eggplant tastes great with yogurt.
vocabulary.note_en: egg + plant: some kinds are small and white, like an egg. In British English it is called "aubergine".

vocabulary.meaning_en: a market where farmers sell their own fresh food
vocabulary.example: We buy our vegetables at the farmers' market every Saturday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a very emotional, theatrical way
vocabulary.example: She sighed dramatically when she saw the bill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an animal you keep at home for company
vocabulary.example: Do you have any pets?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take a child or an animal into your family
vocabulary.example: They adopted a cat from the shelter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: many different types of things
vocabulary.example: The shop has a wide variety of cheeses.
vocabulary.note_en: Usually used with physical things (food, products, choices).

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thick drink made of fruit blended with milk, yogurt or ice
vocabulary.note_ar: أكثف من العصير العادي لأنه مخلوط بالحليب أو الزبادي أو الثلج
vocabulary.example: I make a banana smoothie every morning.
vocabulary.note_en: Thicker than normal juice because it is blended with milk, yogurt or ice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to act as if something is true when it is not
vocabulary.example: He pretended to be asleep.
vocabulary.note_en: pretend to + verb (e.g. pretend to sleep).

vocabulary.meaning_en: to suddenly fall down and lose consciousness
vocabulary.example: It was so hot that a man fainted in the queue.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small table or stall where things are sold
vocabulary.example: There's a lemonade stand outside the school.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who sells things, often in the street
vocabulary.example: The vendor gave us a free apple.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sold at a lower price than usual
vocabulary.example: These shoes are on sale this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very big
vocabulary.example: They ordered a giant pizza.

vocabulary.meaning_en: useful and suitable for a real purpose
vocabulary.note_ar: practical vegetables = خضار مختارة لوصفة معيّنة وليس بشكل عشوائي
vocabulary.example: Trainers are more practical than high heels for walking.
vocabulary.note_en: "practical vegetables" = vegetables chosen for a specific recipe, not picked randomly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: fruit = food from a plant; fruits = different kinds of fruit
vocabulary.note_ar: fruits تعني أنواعاً مختلفة من الفاكهة
vocabulary.example: The market sells tropical fruits from Asia.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
vocabulary.note_ar: انتبه: desert بحرف s واحد = صحراء
vocabulary.example: What's for dessert tonight?
vocabulary.note_en: Careful: "desert" with one s = a large dry, sandy place.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to speak quietly, often because you are annoyed
vocabulary.example: He muttered something and left the room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person whose job is to make people laugh; a funny person
vocabulary.example: My brother thinks he's a comedian.

fine_lines.title: variety vs diversity
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان معناهما «تنوّع». variety تُستخدم غالباً مع الأشياء المادية: أنواع الطعام أو المنتجات أو الأشياء التي تختار منها. أما diversity فتُستخدم أكثر مع البشر والمفاهيم: تنوّع الثقافات والآراء والخلفيات، مثل cultural diversity.

examples.sentence: The bakery sells a variety of breads.
We need more variety in our meals.
Our school is proud of its cultural diversity.
The team has a great diversity of opinions.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Both words mean having many different kinds. "Variety" is usually used with physical things: types of food, products, or things you can choose from. "Diversity" is used more with people and ideas: different cultures, opinions and backgrounds, as in "cultural diversity".

fine_lines.title: lemon vs lime
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في كثير من البلاد العربية نقول «ليمون» للنوعين، لكن الإنجليزية تفرّق بينهما: lemon هو الليمون الأصفر الكبير، و lime هو الليمون الأخضر الصغير.

examples.sentence: Squeeze a yellow lemon over the salad.
This drink is made with fresh lime and mint.

fine_lines.explanation_en: In many languages one word covers both fruits, but English separates them: a "lemon" is the big yellow one, and a "lime" is the small green one.

fine_lines.title: fruit vs fruits
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fruit عادةً اسم لا يُعدّ ويعني الفاكهة بشكل عام (I eat a lot of fruit). أما fruits فتُستخدم عندما نقصد أنواعاً مختلفة من الفاكهة، تماماً مثل «فاكهة» و«فواكه» في العربية.

examples.sentence: Mangoes and papayas are tropical fruits.

fine_lines.explanation_en: "Fruit" is usually uncountable and means fruit in general (I eat a lot of fruit). We use "fruits" when we mean different kinds of fruit.

fine_lines.title: dessert vs desert
fine_lines.explanation_ar: dessert (بحرفي s) هي الحلوى بعد الوجبة، و desert (بحرف s واحد) هي الصحراء. طريقة سهلة للتذكّر: الحلوى تريد منها المزيد، لذلك فيها حرفا s.

examples.sentence: We had ice cream for dessert.
Camels can live in the desert.

fine_lines.explanation_en: "Dessert" (two s's) is the sweet food after a meal, and "desert" (one s) is a hot, dry, sandy place. Easy way to remember: you always want more dessert, so it has two s's.

expressions.meaning_ar: هادئ جداً ولا يتوتّر مهما كانت الظروف (قلب الخيار أبرد من الجو حوله)
expressions.example: The exam was hard, but she stayed cool as a cucumber.

expressions.meaning_ar: لأغراض درامية / لإثارة الدهشة ولفت الانتباه
expressions.example: He paused for dramatic effect before telling us the news.
expressions.meaning_en: to surprise people or get their attention

expressions.example: Dramatic as ever, Tom said it was the worst day of his life.

expressions.meaning_en: sold at a lower price than usual

expressions.phrase: by the end of the day
expressions.example: By the end of the day, we were all tired.
expressions.meaning_en: when the day is finished; before the day ends

expressions.example: These eggs are fresh from the farm.
expressions.meaning_en: very fresh, coming straight from the farm

grammar.title: Present perfect: life experience
grammar.explanation_ar: المضارع التام (have/has + التصريف الثالث) هو «زمن الخبرات الحياتية». تخيّل أن حياتك جواز سفر، وكل تجربة تمرّ بها ختم فيه. عندما نسأل: هل حدث هذا في حياتك أم لا؟ دون أن يهمّنا متى، نستخدم المضارع التام. القاعدة: إذا كان الحدث أهم من الوقت → مضارع تام.
examples: I have eaten sushi. (I know what sushi is like.)
Have you ever tried mango juice?
grammar.explanation_en: The present perfect (have/has + past participle) is the tense of life experiences. Imagine your life is a passport, and every experience is a stamp in it. When we ask whether something has happened in your life or not, and we don't care when, we use the present perfect. Rule: if the action matters more than the time → present perfect.

grammar.title: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.explanation_ar: بمجرد أن نذكر وقتاً محدداً في الماضي (yesterday, last Friday, in 2019, ten minutes ago) فنحن نحكي حدثاً معيّناً ولا نتكلم عن خبرة، لذلك نستخدم الماضي البسيط. I ate sushi yesterday وليس I have eaten sushi yesterday.
examples: I have traveled to France. / I traveled to France in 2019.
I lost my keys ten minutes ago.
I visited my grandma last Friday.
grammar.explanation_en: As soon as we mention a specific time in the past (yesterday, last Friday, in 2019, ten minutes ago), we are telling a particular story, not talking about an experience, so we use the past simple. Say "I ate sushi yesterday", not "I have eaten sushi yesterday".

questions.question: Which fruit is a "water + melon"?
questions.explanation_ar: watermelon = بطيخ، أي الشمام المليء بالماء.
questions.explanation_en: A watermelon is a melon full of water.

questions.question: A small green sour fruit is a:
questions.explanation_ar: lime هو الليمون الأخضر، و lemon هو الأصفر.
questions.explanation_en: A lime is the small green one; a lemon is the yellow one.

questions.question: Our city is famous for its cultural ___.
questions.explanation_en: With people and cultures we use "diversity".

questions.question: The supermarket has a wide ___ of snacks.
questions.explanation_ar: مع الأشياء المادية مثل المنتجات نستخدم variety.
questions.explanation_en: With physical things like products we use "variety".

questions.question: "Cool as a cucumber" describes a person who is:
questions.explanation_ar: المعنى: شخص هادئ جداً لا يتوتر.
questions.explanation_en: It means a person who stays very calm and doesn't get stressed.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I have visited Paris last year.
I has visited Paris last year.
questions.explanation_ar: last year وقت محدد، لذلك نستخدم الماضي البسيط visited.
questions.explanation_en: "Last year" is a specific time, so we use the past simple: visited.

questions.question: ___ you ever eaten Chinese food?
questions.explanation_ar: نسأل عن خبرة حياتية دون وقت محدد: Have you ever eaten...?
questions.explanation_en: We are asking about a life experience with no specific time: Have you ever eaten...?

questions.question: My friend ___ that movie three times.
questions.explanation_ar: خبرة حياتية بلا وقت محدد مع فاعل مفرد: has seen.
questions.explanation_en: A life experience with no specific time and a singular subject: has seen.

questions.question: The children wanted to ___ a puppy from the shelter.
questions.explanation_en: To adopt = to take a child or an animal into your family.

questions.question: What do we call sweet food eaten after a meal?
questions.explanation_ar: dessert بحرفي s هي الحلوى، أما desert فهي الصحراء.
questions.explanation_en: "Dessert" with two s's is sweet food; "desert" is a dry, sandy place.
